verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with an OpenAPI 3.0 reference and an HTTP ingestion API. Nothing in the evidence describes API versioning (version paths, headers or release channels) or a documented deprecation policy. Having an API is related to this story but does not deliver it, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
